title: 11:12 ensign. A flag or banner will be raised on a high mountain for all of Israel's outcasts to see, prompting them to gather around it. The ensign represents the gospel of Jesus Christ (D&C 45:9) and the light that accompanies it (D&C 115:4-5; 18 see also commentary on 5:26-30).
author: Tina M. Peterson
